WeaponAddon_FrostforgedCrescent_Effect:
Basic attacks are fixed to the first slash.
Every basic attack swing triggers your Scabbard of Exorcism regardless of its charge time.
The special attack becomes Sheathe. While sheathed, a frost glow surrounds you, movement speed is increased by 60% and sheathed attacks scale with attack speed.
Attacks from the sheathed stance also trigger the Scabbard of Exorcism, and your Voluspa fires along with it toward your aim.
Extra-trigger effects of Ice Armaments still apply.
